en: A monochrome view of a stone interior passageway or corridor, likely within an old fortress or religious structure. Light floods in from an arched opening at the far end, illuminating pointed, Gothic- or Islamic-style arches receding into the distance. The stone walls are rough and partially deteriorated, with debris visible on the floor. On the right wall near the foreground, a handwritten number '4438' appears.
